_comment: Thresholds for the deterministic rubric pre-flight (P04). Fail-level bands mirror score.py / RUBRIC.md and P01 RUBRIC_METRIC_TARGETS; house-tic and nominalization are DIAGNOSTIC (warn-only, never fail). Rates here are FRACTIONS in [0,1] (tellRate/transferRatio), not score.py's 0..100 percentages. Do NOT tighten a fail band or flip a warn-only metric to fail without a zero-false-positive calibration against book-packages/*.v21.json.
